name: Skill Check with Token Usage Dashboard

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  evaluate-skills:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'

      - name: Build skill validator
        run: |
          cd eng/skill-validator
          dotnet build -c Release

      - name: Run skill evaluation with token tracking
        id: evaluate
        run: |
          cd eng/skill-validator
          dotnet run --project SkillValidator.csproj -- --evaluate --verbose --runs 3 --model claude-opus-4.6 --judge-model claude-opus-4.6
          
          # Capture token usage data
          if [ -f "token-usage.json" ]; then
            echo "Token usage data collected successfully"
          else
            echo "No token usage data found"
          fi

      - name: Upload token usage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-data
          path: eng/skill-validator/token-usage.json
          retention-days: 30

  generate-dashboard-data:
    needs: evaluate-skills
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download token usage artifacts
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          workflow: evaluation.yml
          workflow_search: latest
          name: token-usage-data
          path: ./artifacts

      - name: Generate dashboard data
        run: |
          mkdir -p ./dashboard-data
          powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./eng/dashboard/generate-token-data.ps1 -InputPath ./artifacts -OutputPath ./dashboard-data

      - name: Upload dashboard data artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: ./dashboard-data
          retention-days: 30

  render-dashboard:
    needs: generate-dashboard-data
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download dashboard data
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dashboard-data
          path: ./dashboard-data

      - name: Render dashboard HTML
        run: |
          cp ./eng/dashboard/dashboard.html ./dashboard.html
          cp ./eng/dashboard/dashboard.js ./dashboard.js
          # Inject dashboard data into HTML template
          echo "<script>const dashboardData = $(cat ./dashboard-data/*.json);</script>" > ./dashboard-data/script.js
          cat ./dashboard-data/script.js >> ./dashboard.html

      - name: Upload rendered dashboard
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-dashboard
          path: ./dashboard.html
          retention-days: 30

  publish-dashboard:
    needs: render-dashboard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download dashboard artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage-dashboard
          path: ./dist

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./dist
          publish_branch: gh-pages
          enable_jekyll: false
          allow_empty_commit: false
          force_orphan: true
